case.title: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH. Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter. Need: 4580 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 54 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200003. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and a Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for your offer and for setting out your cost drivers so clearly. We value our long cooperation. Our own data shows a different picture:

Our orders of Frequency converter 7.5 kW, IP55 with you were placed at EUR 414.61 on 2024-10-14 (po:4500011548-10), EUR 400.19 on 2025-06-30 (po:4500012634-10), EUR 412.74 on 2026-01-27 (po:4500013491-10) and EUR 412.74 on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014465-10): the price has not risen.

Your on-time delivery was 84.6% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70530@2026Q3).

Against this background, we have prepared three structured options that should be easy to take to your pricing committee. The longer contract term in each option gives you planning security, and Option A and Option B also offer extended payment terms:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 401.34; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option B: unit price EUR 389.61; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option C: unit price EUR 398.68; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.

We are happy to provide any further information your approval requires.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. While we acknowledge the historical prices you cited, our current cost structure requires an adjustment. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION. Our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. We appreciate your structured options and the proposal for a 24-month contract term, which provides mutual planning security. 

Our Angebot stands at a price of €430.31 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. Building on your Option C, we can offer a revised price of EUR 428.85 per unit for a 24-month term with 30 days net payment, alongside a price of €428.85 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Legal Department: Please note that our general terms and conditions apply to this process; furthermore, the quote lists our standard terms.

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We acknowledge your revised options and appreciate your continued flexibility.

Our main offer stands at a price of €430.31 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months.

As previously stated, our management has frozen all price reductions, meaning we cannot lower the price for the terms already discussed; however, building on your Option B, we can offer a unit price of EUR 429.58 for a 24-month contract with 45 days net payment, with a price of €429.58 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.

Should you be in a position to increase the annual volume, we would be willing to re-evaluate the calculation. Which volume can you commit to? Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Option C: unit price EUR 405.43; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
